collection_property_descriptions.template: Template(s) to use for this definition.
collection_property_descriptions.variables: Template variable overrides for this collection block.
collection_property_descriptions.blank_collection: Create the collection with no builders and no items.
collection_property_descriptions.build_collection: When false, collection won't be created but items can still go to Radarr/Sonarr.
collection_property_descriptions.cache_builders: Number of days to cache builder results. 0 = no cache.
collection_property_descriptions.changes_webhooks: Override the changes webhook for just this definition.
collection_property_descriptions.default_percent: Default percent for episode/season/track/album special filters.
collection_property_descriptions.delete_collections_named: Delete Plex collections with these names.
collection_property_descriptions.hub_priority: Priority position for this collection's Recommendation Hub row. Lower numbers appear first.
collection_property_descriptions.name: Override the collection name in Plex.
collection_property_descriptions.name_mapping: Folder name in the Image Assets Directory.
collection_property_descriptions.sync_to_trakt_list: Trakt list slug to sync this definition to.
collection_property_descriptions.file_logo: Local path to a logo image.
collection_property_descriptions.url_logo: URL of a logo image to apply to the collection.
collection_property_descriptions.smart_label: Make this a Smart Label Collection.
collection_property_descriptions.plex_all: Get every item in the library.
collection_property_descriptions.plex_watchlist: Get every item in your Watchlist, sorted by the given option.
collection_property_descriptions.plex_pilots: Get the first episode of every show. Requires builder_level: episode.
collection_property_descriptions.tmdb_collection_details: TMDb Collection ID(s) or URL(s). Also fetches summary/poster/background.
collection_property_descriptions.tmdb_movie_details: TMDb Movie ID(s) or URL(s). Also fetches summary/poster/background.
collection_property_descriptions.tmdb_show_details: TMDb Show ID(s) or URL(s). Also fetches summary/poster/background.
collection_property_descriptions.tmdb_list_details: TMDb List ID(s) or URL(s). Also fetches description.
collection_property_descriptions.tmdb_actor: TMDb Person ID(s) to build from their acting credits.
collection_property_descriptions.tmdb_director: TMDb Person ID(s) to build from their directing credits.
collection_property_descriptions.tmdb_producer: TMDb Person ID(s) to build from their producing credits.
collection_property_descriptions.tmdb_writer: TMDb Person ID(s) to build from their writing credits.
collection_property_descriptions.tmdb_crew: TMDb Person ID(s) to build from their crew credits.
collection_property_descriptions.tmdb_actor_details: TMDb Person ID(s) for acting credits. Also fetches person info.
collection_property_descriptions.tmdb_crew_details: TMDb Person ID(s) for crew credits. Also fetches person info.
collection_property_descriptions.tmdb_director_details: TMDb Person ID(s) for directing credits. Also fetches person info.
collection_property_descriptions.tmdb_producer_details: TMDb Person ID(s) for producing credits. Also fetches person info.
collection_property_descriptions.tmdb_writer_details: TMDb Person ID(s) for writing credits. Also fetches person info.
collection_property_descriptions.tmdb_popular: Number of popular TMDb movies/shows to get.
collection_property_descriptions.tmdb_top_rated: Number of top-rated TMDb movies/shows to get.
collection_property_descriptions.tmdb_now_playing: Number of now-playing TMDb movies to get.
collection_property_descriptions.tmdb_upcoming: Number of upcoming TMDb movies to get.
collection_property_descriptions.tmdb_airing_today: Number of airing-today TMDb shows to get.
collection_property_descriptions.tmdb_on_the_air: Number of on-the-air TMDb shows to get.
collection_property_descriptions.tmdb_trending_daily: Number of daily trending TMDb items to get.
collection_property_descriptions.tmdb_trending_weekly: Number of weekly trending TMDb items to get.
collection_property_descriptions.tmdb_discover: TMDb Discover search. Uses TMDb's Discover API with movie or show search attributes.
collection_property_descriptions.tvdb_list_details: TVDb List URL(s). Also fetches description.
collection_property_descriptions.tvdb_show_details: TVDb Series ID(s) or URL(s). Also fetches summary/poster/background.
collection_property_descriptions.tvdb_movie_details: TVDb Movie ID(s) or URL(s). Also fetches summary/poster/background.
collection_property_descriptions.trakt_list_details: Trakt List URL(s). Also fetches description.
collection_property_descriptions.trakt_boxoffice: Get Trakt's Top Box Office movies (always 10).
collection_property_descriptions.radarr_taglist: Get Radarr movies by tag(s). Leave blank for untagged movies.
collection_property_descriptions.sonarr_taglist: Get Sonarr shows by tag(s). Leave blank for untagged shows.
collection_property_descriptions.mdblist_list: MDBList List URL(s) or object with url and limit.
collection_property_descriptions.letterboxd_list_details: Letterboxd List URL(s). Also fetches description.
collection_property_descriptions.letterboxd_crew: Movies credited to a Letterboxd person in a selected role.
collection_property_descriptions.letterboxd_user_films_details: Letterboxd user films page(s). Also fetches details.
collection_property_descriptions.letterboxd_user_reviews_details: Letterboxd user reviews page(s). Also fetches details.
collection_property_descriptions.yamtrack_list_details: YamTrack List URL(s). Also fetches description.
collection_property_descriptions.yamtrack_tracked: YamTrack tracked movies and shows filtered by status.
collection_property_descriptions.icheckmovies_list_details: ICheckMovies List URL(s). Also fetches description.
collection_property_descriptions.mojo_world: BoxOfficeMojo worldwide chart for a given year.
collection_property_descriptions.mojo_record: BoxOfficeMojo record chart (opening weekend, per-theater averages, etc.).
collection_property_descriptions.mojo_never: BoxOfficeMojo 'Never in the Top N' chart.
collection_property_descriptions.simkl_trending: Simkl trending titles. Integer limit or object with period and limit.
collection_property_descriptions.simkl_dvd: Simkl DVD releases. Integer limit or object with limit.
collection_property_descriptions.text_file: Path(s) to a plain-text file containing one IMDb/TMDb/TVDb ID per line.
collection_property_descriptions.anidb_id: AniDB ID(s). Accepts integer, comma-separated string, or array.
collection_property_descriptions.anidb_relation: AniDB ID to get all relations of.
collection_property_descriptions.anidb_popular: Number of items from AniDB's popular anime list (max 30).
collection_property_descriptions.anidb_tag: AniDB Tag(s) to build from. Accepts tag ID, string name, dict with tag_id/limit, or array.
collection_property_descriptions.anidb_tag_name: AniDB Tag(s) by name. Accepts string, dict with tags/min_weight, or array.
collection_property_descriptions.anilist_id: AniList ID(s). Accepts integer, comma-separated string, or array.
collection_property_descriptions.anilist_relations: AniList ID to get all relations of.
collection_property_descriptions.item_label: Apply label(s) to all items found by builders.
collection_property_descriptions.item_tmdb_season_titles: Update season titles from TMDb for matched shows.
collection_property_descriptions.revert_overlay: Revert overlays on items in this collection.
collection_property_descriptions.item_analyze: Trigger Plex analysis (chapter images, etc.) on matched items.
collection_property_descriptions.item_lock_background: Lock/unlock background art on matched items.
collection_property_descriptions.item_lock_poster: Lock/unlock poster art on matched items.
collection_property_descriptions.item_lock_title: Lock/unlock title field on matched items.
collection_property_descriptions.item_critic_rating: Set critic rating on matched items (0.0–10.0, null to clear).
collection_property_descriptions.item_audience_rating: Set audience rating on matched items (0.0–10.0, null to clear).
collection_property_descriptions.item_user_rating: Set user rating on matched items (0.0–10.0, null to clear).
collection_property_descriptions.non_item_remove_label: Remove label(s) from items NOT in this collection.
collection_property_descriptions.item_edition: Set edition field on matched items (null to clear).
collection_property_descriptions.item_radarr_tag: Append Radarr tag(s) to matched items.
collection_property_descriptions.item_sonarr_tag: Append Sonarr tag(s) to matched items.
collection_property_descriptions.item_album_sorting: Set album sort order for matched artist items (music libraries).
collection_property_descriptions.url_square_art: URL of a square art image to apply to the collection.
collection_property_descriptions.file_square_art: Local path to a square art image.
collection_property_descriptions.icheckmovies_description: ICheckMovies list URL to pull a collection description from.
collection_property_descriptions.suppress_overlays: Overlay name(s) to suppress on items in this collection.
collection_property_descriptions.album_sorting: Default album sort order for this library (music libraries).
collection_property_descriptions.asset_folders: Use per-item asset sub-folders instead of a flat asset directory.
collection_property_descriptions.append_label: Append label(s) to matched items without replacing existing labels.
collection_property_descriptions.allowed_library_types: Library type(s) this collection is restricted to.
collection_property_descriptions.tmdb_deathday: TMDb person death-date used in template conditionals.
collection_property_descriptions.filters: Filters applied to items found by builders.
